ko.title: 3시간, 하나의 최후통첩: UN에서 '전멸' 경고 후 트럼프의 미공개 이란 회담

segments.src: On the same day President Donald Trump told the United Nations General Assembly that Iran faces a stark choice, his envoys sat down for roughly three hours of talks with an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of the summit.
segments.tr: 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 유엔 총회에서 이란이 명확한 선택에 직면해 있다고 말한 그날, 그의 특사들은 정상회담 측면에서 이란 대표단과 약 3시간 동안 회담을 진행했습니다.

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: 이 회담은 사전에 공표되지 않았습니다.

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: 트럼프가 기자들에게 설명할 때 공개되었습니다.

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.
segments.tr: 노골적인 공개 위협과 조용한 외교의 결합은 에너지 시장과 중동 정치를 재편한 분쟁이 시작된 지 거의 7개월이 된 긴박한 순간에 미국-이란 관계가 어떻게 처리되고 있는지를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Here is what is known so far, based on public reporting, and what remains unclear.
segments.tr: 공개 보도를 바탕으로 지금까지 알려진 것과 명확하지 않은 것은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## UN에서의 경고

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: 세계 지도자들에 대한 연설에서 트럼프는 상황을 이분법적 선택으로 표현했습니다.

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: 연설 보도에 따르면, 그는 "이슬람 공화국을 전멸"시키고 신속하게 해야 하는지, 아니면 여전히 협상 합의에 도달할 수 있는지를 물었습니다.

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: 이후 기자들과 대화하면서 그는 선택지를 한쪽은 "초토화"이고 다른 한쪽은 이란의 "잠재적 위대함"이라고 설명했습니다.

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: 이 언어는 트럼프가 다자간 포럼에서 테헤란을 향해 사용한 가장 강경한 표현 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: 그것은 또한 협상 입장이었습니다: 거래의 창이 제한적이며 대안이 심각하다는 신호를 보내기 위한 최후통첩이었습니다.

segments.src: ## The Three-Hour Meeting
segments.tr: ## 3시간 회담

segments.src: Shortly after the speech, Trump said U.S.
segments.tr: 연설 직후, 트럼프는 미국

segments.src: and Iranian officials had met at the UN General Assembly, and he called the session "very good" and "very productive."
segments.tr: 과 이란 관리들이 유엔 총회에서 만났다고 말했으며, 그는 이 회의를 "매우 좋은" 것이자 "매우 생산적인" 것이라고 불렀습니다.

segments.src: Participants named in reports include:
segments.tr: 보도에서 이름이 나온 참석자는 다음을 포함합니다:

segments.src: - **Steve Witkoff**, Trump's special envoy
segments.tr: - **Steve Witkoff**, 트럼프의 특별 특사

segments.src: - **Jared Kushner**, Trump's son-in-law and informal adviser
segments.tr: - **Jared Kushner**, 트럼프의 사위이자 비공식 고문

segments.src: - **Abbas Araghchi**, Iran's foreign minister
segments.tr: - **Abbas Araghchi**, 이란의 외무장관

segments.src: Coverage differs on the format.
segments.tr: 형식에 대한 보도가 다릅니다.

segments.src: Some accounts describe a face-to-face meeting.
segments.tr: 일부 보도는 대면 회담을 설명합니다.

segments.src: At least one report said mediators shuttled between the two sides.
segments.tr: 최소한 한 보도는 중재자들이 양쪽 사이를 오갔다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: The White House and Tehran may give further detail in the coming days.
segments.tr: 백악관과 테헤란은 향후 며칠 동안 추가 세부 사항을 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Trump also said another round of talks would take place in the very near future, though no date has been publicly confirmed.
segments.tr: 트럼프는 또한 또 다른 라운드의 회담이 매우 가까운 미래에 진행될 것이라고 말했지만, 공개적으로 확인된 날짜는 없습니다.

segments.src: ## What Iran Says It Wants
segments.tr: ## 이란이 원하는 것

segments.src: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB said Araghchi laid out Tehran's conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway that carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil.
segments.tr: 이란 국영 방송 IRIB는 Araghchi가 세계 해상 석유의 많은 부분을 운반하는 좁은 수로인 호르무즈 해협의 재개를 위한 테헤란의 조건을 제시했다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: According to that account, Iran is asking for:
segments.tr: 그 설명에 따르면, 이란은 다음을 요구하고 있습니다:

segments.src: - An immediate end to the U.S. naval blockade
segments.tr: - 미국 해군 봉쇄의 즉각적인 종료

segments.src: - Release of frozen Iranian assets
segments.tr: - 동결된 이란 자산의 해제

segments.src: - An end to the fighting on all fronts, including Lebanon
segments.tr: - 레바논을 포함한 모든 전선에서의 전투 종료

segments.src: Washington's stated priorities point in a different direction.
segments.tr: 워싱턴의 공표된 우선순위는 다른 방향을 가리킵니다.

segments.src: Reporting on the talks says the U.S.
segments.tr: 회담에 대한 보도는 미국이

segments.src: wants free navigation through the strait and firm limits on Iran's nuclear program.
segments.tr: 해협을 통한 자유로운 항해와 이란의 핵 프로그램에 대한 확실한 제한을 원한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the administration remained open to further engagement if it could lead to real progress, and he repeated the core U.S.
segments.tr: 국무장관 Marco Rubio는 행정부가 실질적인 진전으로 이어질 수 있다면 추가 협력에 개방적으로 남아 있다고 말했으며, 그는 핵심 미국의

segments.src: goal that Iran never obtain a nuclear weapon.
segments.tr: 이란이 절대 핵무기를 얻지 못한다는 목표를 반복했습니다.

segments.src: ## Hard Words on Both Sides
segments.tr: ## 양측의 강경한 언사

segments.src: Iran's response to the "annihilate" remark was also defiant.
segments.tr: "전멸" 발언에 대한 이란의 반응도 도발적이었습니다.

segments.src: Iran's General Staff said its forces were ready to carry out strikes that would be "more crushing and less predictable" than earlier attacks, according to Al Jazeera.
segments.tr: Al Jazeera에 따르면, 이란의 총참모부는 자신의 군대가 이전 공격보다 "더 압도적이고 덜 예측 가능한" 공격을 수행할 준비가 되어 있다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading the rhetoric as a sign that talks are failing.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 수사학적 표현을 회담이 실패하고 있다는 신호로 읽는 것에 대해 경고합니다.

segments.src: Andreas Krieg of King's College London told Al Jazeera that the escalating language works as a "bargaining strategy," letting each government project strength at home while keeping room to negotiate.
segments.tr: 런던 킹스 칼리지의 Andreas Krieg는 Al Jazeera에 강화되는 언어가 "협상 전략"으로 작동한다고 말했으며, 각 정부가 국내에서 강력함을 표현하면서도 협상의 여지를 유지하도록 합니다.

segments.src: On that reading, tough public statements and private meetings are two parts of one process rather than a contradiction.
segments.tr: 그 해석에 따르면, 강경한 공개 성명과 비공식 회의는 모순이 아니라 한 과정의 두 부분입니다.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Factor
segments.tr: ## 중간 선거 요소

segments.src: Timing is a central question.
segments.tr: 시기는 중심적인 질문입니다.

segments.src: Trump indicated that a final agreement may not arrive before the November midterm elections, although accounts of his remarks on the timeline have varied slightly, so it is worth watching for clarification.
segments.tr: 트럼프는 최종 합의가 11월 중간 선거 이전에 도달하지 않을 수 있다고 시사했지만, 시간표에 대한 그의 발언에 대한 설명이 약간 다르므로, 명확히 하기를 주시할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: Domestic politics may be shaping the calendar.
segments.tr: 국내 정치가 일정을 형성하고 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The conflict has pushed up U.S.
segments.tr: 분쟁이 미국

segments.src: fuel prices, according to Al Jazeera, and energy costs are a sensitive issue for voters.
segments.tr: 연료 가격을 높였으며, Al Jazeera에 따르면 에너지 비용은 유권자들에게 민감한 문제입니다.

segments.src: A deal that reopens the Strait of Hormuz could ease that pressure.
segments.tr: 호르무즈 해협을 재개하는 거래는 그 압력을 완화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A deal seen as too generous could draw criticism from opponents in Washington and from U.S.
segments.tr: 너무 관대하게 보이는 거래는 워싱턴의 반대자들과 미국

segments.src: allies in the region.
segments.tr: 지역의 동맹들로부터 비판을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That tension helps explain why both outcomes, a breakthrough and a delay, remain plausible.
segments.tr: 그 긴장은 획기적인 진전과 지연이라는 두 가지 결과가 왜 둘 다 그럴듯한지를 설명하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주시할 사항

segments.src: - **A second round of talks.** Trump said one is coming soon. Whether it is confirmed, and at what level, will signal how serious the process is.
segments.tr: - **두 번째 라운드 회담.** 트럼프는 곧 올 것이라고 말했습니다. 확인 여부와 그 수준이 프로세스가 얼마나 진지한지를 알릴 것입니다.

segments.src: - **The Strait of Hormuz and the blockade.** Any easing of either would be the clearest sign of progress.
segments.tr: - **호르무즈 해협과 봉쇄.** 어느 한쪽의 완화라도 진전의 가장 명확한 신호가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Nuclear terms.** Public detail on enrichment limits and inspections has been scarce.
segments.tr: - **핵 조건.** 농축 제한 및 검사에 대한 공개 세부사항이 부족했습니다.

segments.src: - **Rhetoric versus action.** Watch whether military statements from either side are followed by real escalation or fade as talks continue.
segments.tr: - **수사학과 실행.** 양쪽의 군사 성명이 실제 확대로 이어지는지 아니면 회담이 계속되면서 사라지는지를 주시하세요.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심

segments.src: The UN meeting did not produce a deal, and neither side has said it did.
segments.tr: 유엔 회의는 거래를 낳지 못했으며, 어느 쪽도 그렇다고 말하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: It did show that direct or mediated communication between Washington and Tehran is active even as both governments trade sharp warnings in public.
segments.tr: 그것은 워싱턴과 테헤란 사이의 직접 또는 중재된 통신이 두 정부가 공개적으로 날카로운 경고를 교환하더라도 활발함을 보여주었습니다.

segments.src: Whether that channel leads to an agreement, or whether the ultimatum hardens positions, is likely to become clearer in the weeks before the midterms.
segments.tr: 그 채널이 합의로 이어지는지, 아니면 최후통첩이 입장을 경화시키는지 여부는 중간 선거 전 몇 주 내에 더 명확해질 것 같습니다.

zh.title: 三小时、一份最后通牒：特朗普在联合国发出"彻底摧毁"警告后的未公布伊朗谈判

segments.src: On the same day President Donald Trump told the United Nations General Assembly that Iran faces a stark choice, his envoys sat down for roughly three hours of talks with an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of the summit.
segments.tr: 在特朗普对联合国大会表示伊朗面临严峻选择的同一天，他的特使与伊朗代表团在峰会期间进行了约三小时的谈判。

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: 这次会议事先没有被宣布。

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: 当特朗普向记者描述时才被披露。

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.
segments.tr: 直言不讳的公开威胁与不声不响的外交手段结合在一起，展示了在紧张时刻（冲突已近七个月，重塑了能源市场和中东政治）美国和伊朗关系的处理方式。

segments.src: Here is what is known so far, based on public reporting, and what remains unclear.
segments.tr: 以下是基于公开报道目前已知的信息以及仍未确认的部分。

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## 联合国的警告

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: 在对世界领导人的讲话中，特朗普将局势描绘为一个二选一的问题。

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: 据讲话报道，他问是否应该"彻底摧毁伊斯兰共和国"并迅速行动，或者是否仍能达成谈判协议。

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: 随后在记者会上，他将两个选项描述为一方是"彻底摧毁"，另一方是伊朗的"潜在伟大"。

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: 这些言辞是特朗普在多边论坛上对德黑兰使用的最强硬的语言之一。

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: 这也是一个谈判立场：一项最后通牒，旨在表明达成协议的机会有限，替代方案将非常严重。

segments.tr: 和伊朗官员在联合国大会上进行了会晤，他称这次会议"非常成功"和"非常富有成效"。

segments.src: Participants named in reports include:
segments.tr: 报道中提到的参与者包括：

segments.src: - **Steve Witkoff**, Trump's special envoy
segments.tr: - **Steve Witkoff**，特朗普的特别代表

segments.src: - **Jared Kushner**, Trump's son-in-law and informal adviser

segments.src: - **Abbas Araghchi**, Iran's foreign minister

segments.src: Some accounts describe a face-to-face meeting.
segments.tr: 一些报道描述了面对面的会议。

segments.src: At least one report said mediators shuttled between the two sides.
segments.tr: 至少一份报道称调解人在双方之间来回奔走。

segments.tr: 特朗普还表示另一轮谈判将在不久的将来进行，不过尚未公开确认具体日期。

segments.src: ## What Iran Says It Wants

segments.src: According to that account, Iran is asking for:

segments.tr: - 立即结束美国海军封锁

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: बैठक की पहले से घोषणा नहीं की गई थी।

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: जब ट्रम्प ने इसे पत्रकारों को बताया तो यह सामने आया।

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.
segments.tr: एक कठोर सार्वजनिक धमकी के साथ शांत कूटनीति का मिश्रण दिखाता है कि यू.एस.–ईरान संबंध एक तनावपूर्ण क्षण में कैसे संभाले जा रहे हैं, जब लगभग सात महीने का संघर्ष ऊर्जा बाजारों और मध्य पूर्व की राजनीति को फिर से आकार दे रहा है।

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## यूएन में चेतावनी

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: विश्व नेताओं को अपने भाषण में, ट्रम्प ने स्थिति को एक द्विआधारी विकल्प के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया।

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: भाषण की रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, उन्होंने पूछा कि क्या वह "इस्लामिक रिपब्लिक को विनष्ट" करें और ऐसा जल्दी करें, या क्या एक सहमत समझौता अभी भी पहुंचा जा सकता है।

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: बाद में पत्रकारों से बात करते हुए, उन्होंने विकल्पों को एक तरफ "पूर्ण विनाश" और दूसरी तरफ ईरान के लिए "संभावित महानता" के रूप में वर्णित किया।

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: यह भाषा बहुपक्षीय मंच पर तेहरान के प्रति ट्रम्प द्वारा उपयोग की गई सबसे प्रभावशाली भाषा में से एक थी।

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: यह एक सौदेबाजी की स्थिति भी थी: एक अंतिम चेतावनी जिसका मतलब है कि सौदे के लिए खिड़की सीमित है, और विकल्प गंभीर है।

es.title: Tres Horas, Un Ultimátum: Las Conversaciones No Anunciadas de Trump sobre Irán Después de Su Advertencia de 'Aniquilamiento' en la ONU

segments.src: On the same day President Donald Trump told the United Nations General Assembly that Iran faces a stark choice, his envoys sat down for roughly three hours of talks with an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of the summit.
segments.tr: El mismo día en que el presidente Donald Trump le dijo a la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas que Irán enfrenta una decisión tajante, sus enviados se sentaron para aproximadamente tres horas de conversaciones con una delegación iraní en los márgenes de la cumbre.

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: La reunión no había sido anunciada de antemano.

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: Salió a la luz cuando Trump se la describió a los reporteros.

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.
segments.tr: El emparejamiento de una amenaza pública contundente con la diplomacia silenciosa muestra cómo se están manejando las relaciones entre EE.UU. e Irán en un momento tenso, casi siete meses después de un conflicto que ha remodelado los mercados energéticos y la política de Oriente Medio.

segments.src: Here is what is known so far, based on public reporting, and what remains unclear.
segments.tr: Esto es lo que se sabe hasta ahora, basándose en reportes públicos, y lo que permanece sin aclarar.

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## La Advertencia en la ONU

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: En su discurso a los líderes mundiales, Trump enmarcó la situación como una elección binaria.

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: De acuerdo con reportes del discurso, preguntó si debería "aniquilar la República Islámica" y hacerlo rápidamente, o si aún podría alcanzarse un acuerdo negociado.

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: Hablando con los reporteros después, describió las alternativas como "aniquilamiento" de un lado y "grandeza potencial" para Irán del otro.

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: El lenguaje fue uno de los más contundentes que Trump ha utilizado hacia Teherán en un foro multilateral.

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: También fue una posición de negociación: un ultimátum destinado a señalar que la ventana para un acuerdo es limitada, y que la alternativa es severa.

segments.src: ## What Iran Says It Wants

segments.src: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB said Araghchi laid out Tehran's conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow waterway that carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil.

segments.src: According to that account, Iran is asking for:

segments.src: Iran's response to the "annihilate" remark was also defiant.
segments.tr: La respuesta de Irán a la observación de "aniquilamiento" también fue desafiante.

segments.src: Iran's General Staff said its forces were ready to carry out strikes that would be "more crushing and less predictable" than earlier attacks, according to Al Jazeera.
segments.tr: El Estado Mayor General de Irán dijo que sus fuerzas estaban listas para llevar a cabo ataques que serían "más aplastantes e impredecibles" que los ataques anteriores, según Al Jazeera.

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading the rhetoric as a sign that talks are failing.
segments.tr: Los analistas advierten contra leer la retórica como una señal de que las conversaciones están fracasando.

segments.src: Andreas Krieg of King's College London told Al Jazeera that the escalating language works as a "bargaining strategy," letting each government project strength at home while keeping room to negotiate.
segments.tr: Andreas Krieg del King's College London le dijo a Al Jazeera que el lenguaje cada vez más agresivo funciona como una "estrategia de negociación", permitiendo que cada gobierno proyecte fuerza en casa mientras mantiene espacio para negociar.

segments.src: On that reading, tough public statements and private meetings are two parts of one process rather than a contradiction.
segments.tr: En esa lectura, las declaraciones públicas duras y las reuniones privadas son dos partes de un proceso en lugar de una contradicción.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Factor
segments.tr: ## El Factor de Elecciones Intermedias

segments.src: Timing is a central question.
segments.tr: El cronograma es una pregunta central.

segments.src: Trump indicated that a final agreement may not arrive before the November midterm elections, although accounts of his remarks on the timeline have varied slightly, so it is worth watching for clarification.

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: S'adressant aux journalistes par la suite, il a décrit les alternatives comme « l'anéantissement » d'un côté et la « grandeur potentielle » de l'Iran de l'autre.

segments.src: On the same day President Donald Trump told the United Nations General Assembly that Iran faces a stark choice, his envoys sat down for roughly three hours of talks with an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of the summit.

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: この会談は事前には発表されていなかった。

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: トランプが記者団に説明したときに明らかになった。

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## 国連での警告

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: 世界の指導者への演説で、トランプは状況を二者択一として位置づけた。

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: 演説の報道によると、彼は「イスラム共和国を殲滅」すべきか、そして迅速に行うべきか、または交渉による合意がまだ達成できるかどうかを尋ねた。

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: その後、記者団に対して述べたとき、彼は代替案を一方は「壊滅」、もう一方はイランの「潜在的な偉大さ」と説明した。

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: この言葉遣いは、多国間フォーラムでテヘランに向けてトランプが使用した最も強硬なものの一つだった。

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: それはまた交渉上の立場でもあった。合意の窓が限定的であること、そして代替案が深刻であることを示すための最後通牒である。

segments.src: ## Hard Words on Both Sides

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading the rhetoric as a sign that talks are failing.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Factor

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 次に注視すべきこと

segments.src: - **A second round of talks.** Trump said one is coming soon. Whether it is confirmed, and at what level, will signal how serious the process is.

segments.src: On the same day President Donald Trump told the United Nations General Assembly that Iran faces a stark choice, his envoys sat down for roughly three hours of talks with an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of the summit.
segments.tr: Cùng ngày Tổng thống Donald Trump nói với Đại hội đồng Liên Hợp Quốc rằng Iran đối mặt với một lựa chọn rõ ràng, các đặc sứ của ông đã ngồi trong khoảng ba giờ đàm phán với một đoàn đại biểu Iran ở bên lề hội nghị.

segments.src: The meeting had not been announced beforehand.
segments.tr: Cuộc họp không được công bố trước đó.

segments.src: It came to light when Trump described it to reporters.
segments.tr: Nó được tiết lộ khi Trump mô tả nó với các nhà báo.

segments.src: The pairing of a blunt public threat with quiet diplomacy shows how U.S.–Iran relations are being handled at a tense moment, nearly seven months into a conflict that has reshaped energy markets and Middle East politics.
segments.tr: Sự kết hợp của một lời đe dọa công khai thẳng thắn với ngoại giao yên lặng cho thấy cách các mối quan hệ Mỹ–Iran đang được xử lý tại một thời điểm căng thẳng, gần như bảy tháng trong một cuộc xung đột đã định hình lại các thị trường năng lượng và chính trị Trung Đông.

segments.src: ## The Warning at the UN
segments.tr: ## Cảnh Báo tại Liên Hợp Quốc

segments.src: In his address to world leaders, Trump framed the situation as a binary choice.
segments.tr: Trong bài phát biểu của mình tới các nhà lãnh đạo thế giới, Trump đã trình bày tình huống như một sự lựa chọn nhị phân.

segments.src: According to reports of the speech, he asked whether he should "annihilate the Islamic Republic" and do so quickly, or whether a negotiated agreement could still be reached.
segments.tr: Theo các báo cáo về bài phát biểu, ông hỏi liệu ông có nên "tiêu diệt Cộng hòa Hồi giáo" và làm điều đó một cách nhanh chóng, hay liệu một thỏa thuận được đàm phán có thể vẫn được đạt được hay không.

segments.src: Speaking to reporters afterward, he described the alternatives as "obliteration" on one side and "potential greatness" for Iran on the other.
segments.tr: Nói chuyện với các nhà báo sau đó, ông mô tả các phương án khác là "tàn diệt" ở một bên và "sự vĩ đại tiềm năng" cho Iran ở bên kia.

segments.src: The language was among the most forceful Trump has used toward Tehran at a multilateral forum.
segments.tr: Ngôn ngữ này nằm trong số những ngôn từ mạnh mẽ nhất Trump đã sử dụng hướng tới Tehran tại một diễn đàn đa phương.

segments.src: It was also a negotiating position: an ultimatum meant to signal that the window for a deal is limited, and that the alternative is severe.
segments.tr: Nó cũng là một vị trí đàm phán: một tối hậu thư có ý định báo hiệu rằng cửa sổ cho một thỏa thuận là hạn chế, và rằng thay thế là nghiêm trọng.

segments.src: Analysts caution against reading the rhetoric as a sign that talks are failing.
